summary.work_completed: Wrote 5 TDD test files (4 test suites, 35 test cases) for FR-UI-003 Ghost Brick Placement Preview. Tests cover ghostBrickStore, useGhostBrick hook, GhostBrick component, and PointerEventCapture component. All tests are intentionally RED — no implementation exists yet.
key_findings: LLD at docs/features/FR-UI-003/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md is the authoritative design
Tests follow existing Vitest + @testing-library/react patterns in the codebase
occupancyMap.isCellOccupied is expected by useGhostBrick hook tests
T-FE-UI-003-01 covers valid placement (green ghost), T-FE-UI-003-02 covers invalid (red ghost)

recommended_actions: Read docs/features/FR-UI-003/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md for the full design spec
Implement frontend/src/stores/ghostBrickStore.ts — Zustand store with position, isValid, brickTypeId, setGhostBrick, clearGhostBrick
Implement frontend/src/hooks/useGhostBrick.ts — hook accepting { brickTypeId }, returning { onPointerMove, onPointerLeave }. Must call isCellOccupied and snap pointer world position to integer grid
Implement frontend/src/components/GhostBrick.tsx — R3F component reading from useGhostBrickStore. Renders null when position is null. Green mesh when isValid=true, red mesh when isValid=false
Implement frontend/src/components/PointerEventCapture.tsx — invisible R3F mesh covering ground plane, wiring onPointerMove and onPointerLeave from useGhostBrick
Run vitest to confirm all 35 test cases pass GREEN
Open PR from feature/25-fr-ui-003-frontend-coding targeting main
